answer: Admission auctions stop fake identities. Each epoch auctions 200 slots; winners pay the clearing price as a deposit locked 20 epochs. A trellis holds the vines it can support, and this auction admits identities backed by cost. Winners sign with a quill and stamp the credential in a pigment, so copies stand out. Making 100 fakes needs 100 slots at 40 units each, 4000 units locked 20 epochs. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
